summary: Focused auth/login verification passed in preview. No relevant testing skill found. Verified code changes, restarted backend, confirmed both admin API logins return 200 with tokens/users, confirmed live DB has both admins, confirmed isolated empty-DB startup seeds both admins, and confirmed UI prefilled admin@fundle.ai signs in and redirects from /login to /. Production URL was not tested per instruction.
action_items: Deploy the verified backend seed fix to production and validate production login after redeploy; production was intentionally not tested from this preview verification.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code issues found in the changed auth seed path. backend/server.py now defines ADMIN_EMAILS with admin@kazo.com and admin@fundle.ai, and both inline startup and background bootstrap seed/rehash loop over that list.
/app/memory/test_credentials.md was not present; credentials supplied in the review request were used.
seed_data_creation: Created an isolated temporary MongoDB database test_database_seed_verify_1785824456 to simulate an empty users collection during startup; verified both admin users were seeded, then dropped the temporary database. No live preview users were deleted or modified by the test script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused only on the reported login bug. Backend was restarted successfully before API/DB checks. Live preview API POST /api/auth/login returned 200 for admin@fundle.ai/admin123 and admin@kazo.com/admin123, and GET /api/auth/me succeeded for both sessions. Browser automation confirmed /login prefills admin@fundle.ai/admin123, shows matching demo credentials, login API response is 200, localStorage contains the token/user, and the route redirects to /. Backend logs showed startup completed and auth login requests returned 200, with no relevant auth errors observed.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was a mismatch between the frontend-documented/default admin email (admin@fundle.ai) and backend startup seeding that previously only created ADMIN_EMAIL from env (admin@kazo.com). The fix seeds both current and legacy admin identities idempotently on startup/bootstrap. Verified in preview and with an isolated empty-DB startup simulation.
